purpose: Primary canonical texts placed as labeled stars within their associated heteronym's zodiacal region. This is the canon-in-sky surface (orthogonal to the canon-in-cha rooms). Each entry specifies which heteronym's region the star sits in, which real-sky star will be used as the anchor (TBD), and what brightness/magnitude class the text deserves based on its standing in the canon.
status_note: Phase 4 complete 2026-07-03: all canonical texts assigned to HYG stars per EA-STARMAP-01 §3.3 (anchors to canonical anchor-stars; magnitude-banded within zodiacal regions; LOGOS* circumpolar; unattributed texts provisionally in the southern outer-canon belt pending adjudication).

magnitude_classes.primary_canon_star_M1: Bright star (mag 1.0-1.5) — the texts that anchor an entire room. Snub-Poemed, Sappho 31, Revelation, Leaves of Grass.
magnitude_classes.secondary_canon_star_M2: Notable star (mag 1.5-2.5) — significant primary texts within rooms but not the room anchor.
magnitude_classes.tertiary_canon_star_M3: Visible star (mag 2.5-3.5) — important fragments and shorter primary works.
magnitude_classes.cluster_member_M4: Cluster star (mag 3.5-4.5) — texts that operate in constellation with anchor works rather than as independent objects.
